summary: Rank now scores via a prebuilt inverted index (term -> postings(doc,tf) + per-doc length norm + idf, built once with sync.Once) instead of folding/tokenizing all 8000 titles per call; per query it accumulates BM25 contributions in query order only for docs holding a query term (bit-identical summation order) and picks TopK by (score desc, ID asc). Safe: index is read-only after build; per-call scratch (dense scores + touched list) comes from sync.Pool and is zeroed before reuse, so concurrent Rank calls share nothing mutable; no goroutines outlive a call; no exported names/signatures, catalog, query log, Fold or Quote changed. Index adds a few MB (<64MB). Microbench: ~6.08ms/op -> ~2.1us/op (~2800x) and 16010 -> 4 allocs/op on the production query stream.
